categories.main_business_segments: Beijing JingPinTeZhuang Science and Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the development, manufacturing, and sales of military robots, intelligent sensing equipment, simulation and training systems, and intelligent manufacturing equipment. The company also explores civilian applications of advanced military technologies, including digital national defense education and smart manufacturing. Its product portfolio includes bomb disposal robots, reconnaissance robots, multi-purpose robots, nuclear detection robots, firepower strike robots, and various intelligent sensing devices such as handheld reconnaissance equipment and airborne pods.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages core technologies such as multi-sensor fusion detection, miniature high-precision electro-optical gimbals, ultra-wideband radar detection, high-efficiency power drive, adaptive chassis, multi-degree-of-freedom adaptive robotic arms, and advanced human-machine collaboration and control technologies. It integrates artificial intelligence to enhance autonomous navigation, target detection, and decision-making capabilities. Production follows a 'sales-driven production' model with key processes controlled internally and non-core processes outsourced or procured externally, ensuring cost efficiency and quality control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include military clients such as the Chinese armed forces and military industrial groups, as well as industry clients and foreign trade customers. The company serves defense and security sectors with products designed for battlefield reconnaissance, combat support, and emergency rescue. It also targets civilian markets including intelligent manufacturing, digital defense education, smart warehousing, and low-altitude economy sectors. The company actively participates in domestic and international defense exhibitions to promote its products and expand its market presence.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with headquarters and major R&D centers in Beijing and subsidiaries in cities including Xi'an, Chongqing, Shanghai, and Shijiazhuang. It also actively develops overseas markets through strategic partnerships and participation in international defense exhibitions, targeting regions with strong military procurement demand such as the Middle East and Southeast Asia. The company is expanding its global service capabilities to support foreign trade and export of military and civilian products.
categories.supply_chain_position: Beijing JingPinTeZhuang operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on the design, development, and assembly of complete robotic systems, sensing devices, and simulation platforms. It also develops upstream components such as high-performance servo motors and sensor modules to enhance supply chain integration and product competitiveness. The company outsources non-core manufacturing processes while maintaining control over critical production stages including design, assembly, and quality testing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D investment in intelligentization, artificial intelligence integration, and autonomous systems for military robots and sensing equipment. It builds specialized R&D platforms in military robotics, intelligent sensing, simulation, and intelligent manufacturing. Strategic initiatives include expanding AI capabilities in multi-dimensional perception, autonomous navigation, and simulation training, as well as technology spillover to civilian sectors like smart manufacturing and digital defense education. The company emphasizes talent development, innovation management, and patent acquisition to sustain technological leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of military and civilian products including robots, sensing devices, simulation systems, and intelligent manufacturing equipment. The company also earns income from technical services, customized R&D projects, and licensing of proprietary technologies. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales channels, including competitive bidding for military contracts and strategic partnerships for foreign trade. The company recognizes revenue upon product delivery and customer acceptance or completion of contractual R&D milestones.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in the high-tech military equipment sector alongside large state-owned defense groups and research institutes. It holds a leading position in specialized military robotics, intelligent sensing, and simulation training systems, supported by advanced core technologies and multiple patented innovations. The company is recognized as a national high-tech enterprise and a 'Little Giant' specialized firm, with products ranked first in many military tenders. It faces competition from established defense conglomerates but differentiates through AI integration and diversified product applications.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 163.7 million, a 27.39% decrease from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 57.19 million. Total assets stood at RMB 1.76 billion with net assets of RMB 1.56 billion, reflecting an 8.83% and 8.28% decline respectively. R&D investment increased to RMB 54.44 million, accounting for 33.25% of revenue. The company experienced revenue and profit volatility due to contract timing and product mix changes but continues to invest heavily in innovation and capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes advanced intelligentization and AI integration in its military robots and sensing equipment, offering high autonomy, multi-dimensional perception, and robust operational capabilities in complex environments. Its products provide comprehensive solutions for battlefield reconnaissance, precise firepower strikes, and emergency response, with strong adaptability to diverse scenarios. The firm differentiates through proprietary core technologies, extensive patent portfolio, and the ability to extend military-grade technologies to civilian applications such as smart manufacturing and digital defense education, delivering high-performance, reliable, and innovative products to its customers.
